sheets.name: main
strings: Instructions: Copy this template and fill out the inputs in each  sheet/tab as appropriate.
Material properties. One per set per profile line
Profile lines describing the slope geometry
Piezometric line to define pore pressures
Starting  circles for critical circle search
Distributed loads for stage 2 of multistage analysis
Seepage boundary conditions for stage 2 of multistage analysis
Transient seepage boundary conditions and run options

sheets.name: mat
strings: Traditional Mohr-Coulomb failure envelope (c and phi)
Power curve envelope: t = pow_a * (sn + pow_d)^pow_b + pow_c
Generalized Hoek-Brown (rock mass): hb_sci, hb_gsi, hb_mi, hb_d
Elastic / infinite strength (cannot fail). FEM: no yield; LEM: impenetrable

sheets.name: profile
strings: max depth defines the elevation of a horizontal line that is treated as the bottom of the profile
Size: optional target mesh element size inside this line's material zone (blank = global size).

sheets.name: polygon
strings: Polygons coordinates can be input in CW or CCW order.
Type: material zone (default), an SSR analysis overlay, or a mesh refinement region.   Size: optional target mesh element size inside the polygon (blank = global size).

sheets.name: piezo
strings: * piezometric line 2 is only required for rapid drawdown analysis
True piezometric line: u = γw × vertical distance below the line (static head).
Phreatic surface: static head reduced by cos² of the line's slope.

sheets.name: circles
strings: Depth of the bottom of the circle
Circle passes through intercept point defined by Xi, Yi

sheets.name: dloads
strings: Enter non-water loads only — water loads derive automatically from the piezometric line / seepage boundary conditions.

sheets.name: dloads (2)
strings: Enter non-water loads only — water loads derive automatically from the piezometric line / seepage boundary conditions.

sheets.name: reinforce
strings: Label = name used in error messages, summaries, and plots
(x1, y1), (x2, y2) = start and end of reinforcement line
Type = support preset, fills Dir and Appl: Geosynthetic (Tangent, Active), Nail (Axial, Passive), Tieback (Axial, Active), Anchor (Axial, Active)
Dir = force direction at the slip surface (LEM only): Tangent = reorients along slip surface (flexible); Axial = along the reinforcement line (rigid). Set by Type; overtype to override.
Appl = force application (LEM only): Active = allowable force, not divided by FS (default). Passive = ultimate force, divided by FS. Set by Type; overtype to override.
Tmax = tensile capacity (force/length; or force per element if Spacing is given)
Lp1, Lp2 = pullout length at end 1 / end 2 (0 = fully anchored)
Adhesion = soil-reinforcement interface adhesion (blank = use Lp)
Delta = soil-reinforcement interface friction angle (blank = use Lp)
Tend1, Tend2 = anchorage/plate/connection capacity at end 1 / end 2 (0 = friction only)
Spacing = out-of-plane spacing for discrete supports (nails, tiebacks); blank or 1 for geosynthetics
E = modulus of elasticity of reinforcement
Joint = model as slip element; mesh splits along line
kn = joint normal stiffness (blank = from soil E and size)
ks = joint shear stiffness (blank = from soil G and size)
Jred = reduce joint strength in SSRM (blank = Yes)

sheets.name: joints
strings: Label = name used in error messages, summaries, and plots
(x1, y1), (x2, y2) = start and end of joint line
c_res = residual joint cohesion (blank = same as c)
phi_res = residual joint friction angle (blank = same as phi)
kn = joint normal stiffness (blank = from soil E and size)
ks = joint shear stiffness (blank = from soil G and size)
Jred = reduce joint strength in SSRM (blank = Yes)

sheets.name: piles
strings: (x1, y1), (x2, y2) = top and bottom of pile
H = Pile force magnitude (kN/m or lb/ft).
appl = force application (LEM only): Active = allowable force, not divided by FS (default). Passive = ultimate force, divided by FS.
S = center to center pile spacing (ft or m)
Mcap = Moment capacity of pile (force x length)
E = Young's modulus of pile material (force/lengh^2)
